thread:
kira: quick follow-up from today's postmortem on partial responses/timeouts for streaming endpoints. i'm consolidating owners and a short remediation timeline. main focus: reconnect policy, server framing/backpressure, and detection/rollout controls. please claim.
samir: i'll take reconnect policy + SDK changes. plan: standardize exp-jitter policy, enforce max parallel reconnects per client, and add an opt-in resume token cache. drafting RFC + SDK PR. target: RFC by Tue 2026-03-24, PR by Fri 2026-03-27.
noah: server-side owner here. will add defensive frame validation, fix kv-cache reorder edge by switching to sequence-based invalidation, and abort stuck async flushes after 200ms. will add unit + perf regression tests. target branch + tests by Wed 2026-03-25.
ada: observability & rollout guard owner. items: new metric streaming.partial_chunk_rate, SLI: partial_chunk_rate > 0.2% over 5m -> page, add synthetic continuity probe every 2m, and rollout playbook with automatic rollback on metric spikes. dashboards + alert PR by Thu 2026-03-26.
ops-bot: created TASK-5001 (client-reconnect), TASK-5002 (server-framing), TASK-5003 (streaming-observability). Links: https://tracker.redwood/TASK-5001, https://tracker.redwood/TASK-5002, https://tracker.redwood/TASK-5003
kira: recurring-pattern note: matches prior incidents where heartbeat drops + autoscaler churn aligned with partials. action: add a monthly digest that correlates partials, deploys, autoscaler events, and heartbeat misses; platform rotation will own it.
samir: RFC snippet for reconnect policy: ```reconnect: {strategy: "exp-jitter", base_ms: 100, max_ms: 3000, attempts: 6, max_parallel_reconnects: 1, resume_cache_ttl_s: 45}``` will add telemetry connect_attempts and resume_success.
noah: testing plan: add a chaos job that simulates 400 rps ephemeral churn and toggles kv-cache TTL concurrently. need canary capacity. @ada can you reserve a canary pool?
ada: reserving canary-2 Thu 2026-03-26 09:00-11:00 PT. adding rollback triggers: partial_chunk_rate > 0.4% OR 99p latency +25% -> immediate rollback + page.
samir: will include smoke steps in PR: open stream, send 3 prompts, ensure full-continuation + metrics for resume_success.
noah: opened branch https://github.com/redwood/inference/compare/fix/stream-frame-5002 with unit tests and a small repro harness.
samir: RFC posted https://docs.redwood/rfcs/5001-client-reconnect. SDK PR incoming.
ada: dashboards pushed to staging: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/continuity. alert rules staged in alert-manager PR.
kira: owners summary & deadlines:
- Samir: client RFC + SDK PR -> RFC 2026-03-24, PR 2026-03-27 (TASK-5001)
- Noah: server framing + tests -> 2026-03-25 (TASK-5002)
- Nada: dashboards + alerts + canary -> 2026-03-26 (TASK-5003)
we'll have a 25-min sync Fri 2026-03-27 10:00am PT to validate canary readiness and smoke plans. please add a 3-line test plan to your tickets.
samir: acked, will add telemetry and examples.
noah: acked, will include perf regression results.
nada: acked, will add rollback checklist to runbook.
ops-bot: TASK-5001 assigned to samir, TASK-5002 assigned to noah, TASK-5003 assigned to nada. Created on 2026-03-22.
kira: final note: ensure PR descriptions include the oncall smoke checklist and links to the canary slot. thanks team.
